answer: Correlated-Resource Pricing: each action carries a hardware nonce encrypted with a rotating cipher; the coordinator clusters nonces by shared copper/network signatures and applies an umber-band multiplier m=1+α log²(1+cluster size) to that action’s fee. Creating identities is free, but N sybils sharing one host/ASN face superlinear per-action cost; evading clustering requires separate copper, IPs, and timing profiles, so attacker cost scales ~N^1.5 rather than N.
